title: ServerBenchmarkPro
description: Advanced Minecraft server benchmark plugin with Antutu-style scoring, CPU throttling test, and live ActionBar performance analysis.
body:
⚡ ServerBenchmarkPro – Advanced Server Benchmark Tool

ServerBenchmarkPro is a powerful PaperMC plugin that tests your Minecraft server’s performance just like a professional benchmarking tool.

It includes an Antutu-style scoring system, CPU throttling detection, and real-time ActionBar updates, allowing you to easily understand how much load your server can handle.

⚡ Features
- CPU Benchmark Test (multi-thread stress + TPS impact)
- RAM Benchmark Test (memory + garbage collection performance)
- Disk Benchmark Test (read/write simulation)
- Antutu-style total score (0 – 1,000,000)
- CPU Throttling Detection (% performance drop)
- Network Ping Test (average latency)
- Live ActionBar progress updates
- Detailed in-game chat report
- Smart recommendations (players + plugins)
- Performance grade system (A+ to D)

🛠️ Command
- /btest

🔐 Permission
- benchmark.use

⚙️ Configuration
- Editable options in config.yml:
  - Test duration
  - Stress intensity
  - Cooldown time
